assignedTasks.title: Message Bubble Component (Global & Mini-Thread)
assignedTasks.description:
Create the base message bubble component. Requirements:
1. Avatar circle with dynamic background color (based on initials).
2. Name and tag (e.g., 'Host', 'Following').
3. Timestamp (e.g., '4:12 PM').
4. Message body text (14px/0.875rem).
5. Action footer: 'Open threads', 'Edit' (if owner), 'Delete', 'Report'.
6. Bottom border separator.

assignedTasks.title: Thread Tree Indentation Logic
assignedTasks.description:
Build the recursive threaded message list view for 'Your Threads' and 'Mini Thread' screens. Requirements:
1. Parent message at Level 0.
2. Replies indented by 24px per level (max 4 visible levels).
3. Render vertical/horizontal connector lines (#333333) between parent and children.
4. Expand/Collapse thread branch toggle logic.

assignedTasks.title: Global Chat Input Bar
assignedTasks.description:
Develop the fixed bottom input bar for chatting. Requirements:
1. Context label above input (e.g., 'Replying into #global-room').
2. Rounded text input field.
3. Send button (icon).
4. Auto-resize input height based on text lines (max 4 lines).
5. Footer text indicating timer/editing rules.

assignedTasks.title: Empty State: Your Threads
assignedTasks.description:
Implement the empty state view for the 'Your Threads' screen. Requirements:
1. Central icon placeholder (💬).
2. 'You haven\'t joined any threads yet' text.
3. Call-to-action button: 'Explore Topics' routing to the explore page.
